parsed.explanation: Same-sex law is secondary, but here the dossier documents it used as a lever against gender-nonconforming people: a trans woman convicted under s.153 in 2021 to 8 years in a men's prison, another to 14 years, and a 2018 report finding police arbitrarily arrest, detain and sometimes assault transgender people. Penalties run to 14 years with corporal punishment, confirmed by the 2024 constitutional court, with a moratorium annulled and police shown circumventing it. Arrest brings extortion, forced stripping/examinations, mob assault and outing. Official hostility reaches presidential threats and an unprosecuted kill call, showing no working recourse. This is recurring state targeting with severe penalties and failed remedy, just short of the documented custody sexual-violence/sweep intensity of the 0.15 anchors.
